dedupe_keys.name: iber two dimensional hydraulic model for free surface flow in rivers and estuaries

description: Iber is a two-dimensional hydraulic model for simulating free surface flow in rivers and estuaries, produced by the GEAMA group at Universidade da Coruña and Institut Flumen at the Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya with CIMNE and the support of CEDEX. It solves hydrodynamics, turbulence, sediment transport, water quality and habitat, and a large wood transport module was added in 2025. Version 3.4.1 (March 2026) runs with GiD on Windows and Linux, and IberGIS 1.1.0 runs in QGIS; the software and a hydraulic reference manual, application guide, benchmark report and teaching package are free to download after registration, in English and Spanish. Coverage is any river or estuary reach with a terrain model. The use is governed by the Iber licence agreement enclosed with the software, which prohibits reproduction and redistribution. Caveats: registration is required, redistribution is prohibited, and the team states it gives no assistance. Simulation uses: river flood hazard mapping, dam break and levee scenarios for emergency planning, and climate adaptation of flood defences. Related records: HEC-RAS (model-hec-ras) and LISFLOOD-FP (model-lisflood-fp).
